land-detail.webp uses the diffuse maps from Poly Haven as terrain detail.
Red: Aerial Grass Rock — https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
Green: Rocky Terrain and Mossy Rock — https://polyhaven.com/a/rocky_terrain
        https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock
Blue: Rock Face — https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face
